description: This file defines a React context provider for managing store session state, including customer authentication, store preferences, and UI options. It handles persistence, synchronization across tabs, and provides actions for login, registration, and logout.

classes.name: StoreSessionState
classes.description: Type representing the current store session state, including preferences and auth info.

classes.name: StoreSessionDerived
classes.description: Type representing derived data from the session state, such as authentication status and labels.

classes.name: StoreSessionActions
classes.description: Type defining actions that modify the session state, including login, logout, and preference toggles.

classes.name: StoreSessionContextValue
classes.description: Type combining state, derived data, and actions for context sharing.

methods.name: guestAuthSession
methods.description: Creates a default guest authentication session object.

methods.name: computeAuthLabel
methods.description: Generates a user-friendly label for the current auth session.

methods.name: StoreSessionProvider
methods.description: React component providing store session context, managing state, effects, and actions.

methods.name: useStoreSession
methods.description: Custom hook to access the store session context.
